tool: image generation tool supporting reference images and alpha transparency
instructions: Replace the character-specific placeholders using official brand research and an original fictional design. Read atlas-contract.md before generation. Pass the actual reference images, not just filenames. Record the final expanded prompt with the saved image.
prompt:
Create a Sandbox Wars cyberpunk pixel-art fighter for [PROVIDER / EXACT PRODUCT]. Use the attached E2B and Modal sheets as style references: adult arcade/anime anatomy, angular faces, selective crisp pixel outlines, broad readable shading and restrained color ramps. Create an original fictional character with [DISTINCTIVE SILHOUETTE], [HAIR / HEADGEAR], [SIGNATURE EQUIPMENT], [COSTUME], [VERIFIED BRAND COLOR CUES] and [PERSONALITY / IDLE STANCE]. Keep the same costume, equipment sides, anatomy and scale in every pose. Avoid photorealism, soft painted texture, cute proportions and generic hoodie-boxer redesigns.

Output one square true-alpha transparent PNG containing exactly nine cells in a strict 3-by-3 equal grid. Leave at least 10 percent transparent padding on every cell edge; keep standing figures within 76 percent of the cell height. No clipped limbs, overlapping cells, text, logos, labels, grid lines, drawn checkerboard, background, floor or ground shadows. Top six cells: six clean near-identical idle frames with quiet breathing, planted feet and a smooth last-to-first transition; no injuries or equipment switching. Bottom left: battered seated defeat, complete body, same gear. Bottom center: tired battered victory, complete body, same gear. Bottom right: clean head-and-shoulders portrait with full hair/headgear, expressive adult face, and no injuries. Damage appears only in defeat and victory. Preserve the visual identity and reference-quality pixel rendering across all nine cells.
